units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 33:25">Targ. Y. Num. XXXIII, 25</cite> (transl. <he>מקהלות</he>) <he>אתר כ׳</he>.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 60b:18">Sabb. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>איכא כי׳</he> there is a large gathering (in synagogues &c.).
<cite ref="Shabbat 60b:18">Ib.</cite> <he>כי׳ דאיסורא</he> gathering on a day when labor is not permitted.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 27a:14">R. Hash. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>כל כי׳ דכסף הוא</he> all signals for assemblies were blown on silver horns.
<cite ref="Yoma 51a:5">Yoma 51ᵃ</cite> <he>אתי בכ׳</he> is offered by large crowds.

<cite ref="Gittin 11a:9">Gitt. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>כ׳ דארמאי</he> Ar. a. Rashi (ed. <he>כְּנוּפְיָאתָא</he> pl.) popular assemblies of gentiles, opp. <cite ref="P01379"><he>ערכאות</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="P01381"><he>עַרְכִי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 113a:9">B. Kam. 113ᵃ</cite> <he>וכי לדידכו כְּנוּפַיְכוּ</he> is your gathering (v. <cite ref="K00691"><he>כַּלָּה</he></cite>) held for your individual benefit? (Var. v. <cite ref="K00872"><he>כְּנַף</he> I</cite>).—Pl. <he>כְּנוּפְיָאתָא</he>, v. supra.
